text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. For example, you can type a few words, and an app will produce a picture in seconds. Some people worry that this will replace human artists. However, AI and human creativity are quite different. AI learns from existing data and copies patterns, but it cannot feel emotions or understand life experiences. Humans create from imagination, feelings, and personal stories. Perhaps the best result is when people and AI work together, using technology as a tool to support new ideas.
